headline: Lincoln finish conference play without a defeat
dek: Lincoln closed their conference schedule by beating McKendree on Tuesday and are still without a defeat, with twelve wins and four draws in all and eleven goals conceded. Drury and Maryville, level in second, have both lost to them.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southwest Baptist have scored forty-five goals, more than either Lincoln or Drury near the top, but they have conceded thirty-six and lost seven times; the leaders have built their place at the other end of the pitch.

wire.line: Lincoln are the only programme in the conference still without a defeat this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches past their date carry no result, and both are Drury's, one at home and one away, both from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Drury have conceded fourteen goals and lost three times: at home to Oklahoma Christian in August, away at Missouri S&T in September, and at home to Lincoln on Saturday.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Jonathan Nemorden, a freshman, has twelve of Lincoln's thirty-six goals, from fifty-eight shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Truman have scored twenty-five goals and conceded twenty-seven, and Jacob Panagos has fourteen of the twenty-five from forty-nine shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Noah Nymark-Pedersen has made seventy-nine saves for Upper Iowa and conceded thirty-five, a save percentage of .693.

last_match.line: Lincoln end their conference schedule without a defeat; McKendree had kept a clean sheet in every match since William Jewell scored against them earlier this month.

next_match.line: Drury won the September meeting away from home; Missouri-St. Louis come in off a win at Missouri S&T, Drury off their home defeat by Lincoln.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
